sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The “J.C. Bose fellowship” is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Education and training grants, fellowship, stipend

**Detailed Description:** The “J.C. Bose fellowship” is awarded to active scientists in recognition of their outstanding performance. The fellowship is scientist-specific and very selective. The scientist should be in service at the time of nomination to this fellowship. The nominee should be an Indian national working in institutions in India. > **Duration of Fellowship:** - The duration of the fellowship will be initially for five years. In case, the fellow superannuates during the term of the fellowship, the fellowship can be continued if a host institution is willing to host the fellowship - The tenure of the fellowship may be extended for the subsequent term of 5 years based on a rigorous assessment of research performance during the tenure of the fellowship. A minimum of 25% of the applicants seeking an extension will not be granted the extension.

**Benefits / Assistance:** 1. The fellowship amount is ₹25,000/- per month in addition to regular income. 1. Research grant of ₹15 lakhs per annum. 1. Overhead of ₹1.00 lakh per annum to the host institute.

**Application Process:** > **Nomination:** - The nominations can be sent by the Heads of the Institutions; JC Bose Fellows and Presidents of National Science Academies. - The nominations are received throughout the year. > **Online Application Procedure:** For successful online submission of the application the following points may be noted- **Step 01:** The Nominator should first register on the online website. [Click here to register](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/Registration) **Step 02:** After [login](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB/HomePage#aboutus), go to Menu --&gt; Proposal Submission --&gt; Form Submission. **Step 03:** Some of the details of the Nominee like Name, email, contact details, area of specialization, educational qualifications, employment details &amp; research experience, etc. have to be entered at the time of submission. **Step 04:** Research Contribution in the Last 5 years of the Nominee has to be uploaded in a single PDF file not more than 10 MB. > **Contact Details:** **Member Secretary:** Dr. Jacob V.V. Science and Engineering Research Board 3rd &amp; 4th Floor, Block II, Technology Bhavan, New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi-110016, Tel: +91-11-26552216 Email: Jacob@nic.in **Program Coordinator:** Dr. Shashi Bhushan Pandey, Scientist &#39;G&#39; [Complete guideline for Nominator for SERB-online system](https://www.serbonline.in/SERB_Help/pi/Multiscreen_HTML5/desktop/Propsosal_Submission_For_JC_BOSE.htm)

**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Science And Engineering Research Board, Government Of India; Nodal Department: Department Of Science & Technology; Nodal Ministry: Ministry Of Science And Technology
